 10class Renderable_CardInfo:
 11    """
 12    This class defines how the info  text for a
 13    card is is rendered. The info text describes the cards
 14    functionality.
 15
 16    This class works by first getting the page parts to render with positions
 17    as a container class using Renderable_CardInfo.get_info_page_parts,
 18    then some time later rendering the page parts to the given screen by passing
 19    the container class to Renderable_CardInfo.render_info_page_parts
 20    """
 21
 22    class InfoPagePartContainer:
 23        """
 24        Container class for the various items constituating
 25        the info page.
 26        """
 27
 28        def __init__(
 29                    self,
 30                    frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
 31                    headline: rendered_surface_position_tuples_t,
 32                    image_surface: pygame.Surface,
 33                    image_pos: tuple[int, int],
 34                    textbox: Textbox,
 35                    textbox_pos: tuple[int, int],
 36                    full_image_surface: pygame.Surface,
 37                    full_image_pos: tuple[int, int],
 38                    areas: list[pygame.Rect]
 39                    ):
 40
 41            self.frame_dim = frame_dim
 42            """
 43            The rectangle defining the pages position, width and length.
 44            """
 45            self.headline = headline
 46            """
 47            (surface, position) tuples for the headline
 48            """
 49            self.image_surface: pygame.Surface = image_surface
 50            """
 51            Surface for the image displayed.
 52            """
 53            self.image_pos: tuple[int, int] = image_pos
 54            """
 55            (x, y) position of the image. This is not relative to
 56            the frame_dim origin (0, 0), but is (actual_position_inside_frame_dim + frame_dim_origin)
 57            """
 58            self.textbox: Textbox = textbox
 59            """
 60            The textbox displaying the description text.
 61            """
 62            self.textbox_pos: tuple[int, int] = textbox_pos
 63            """
 64            (x, y) position of the textbox. This is not relative to
 65            the frame_dim origin (0, 0), but is (actual_position_inside_frame_dim + frame_dim_origin).
 66            This is not used for rendering, but can be retreived as info.
 67            """
 68            self.full_image_surface: pygame.Surface = full_image_surface
 69            """
 70            The full image that will be shown in fullscreen dimensions.
 71            """
 72            self.full_image_pos: tuple[int, int] = full_image_pos
 73            """
 74            (x, y) of the full image. This is centered inside the fullscreen rectangle.
 75            """
 76            self.areas: list[pygame.Rect] = areas
 77            """
 78            List of the areas the frame_dim is split up into from top to bottom.
 79            """
 80
 81        def get_blit_surface_position_tuples(self) -> tuple[ tuple[ pygame.Surface, tuple[ int, int ] ] ]:
 82            """
 83            Returns a list of (surface, position),
 84            of all the parts that should be rendered this way.
 85            """
 86
 87            sp_list =   [
 88                        *self.headline,
 89                        (self.image_surface, self.image_pos)
 90                        ]
 91
 92            return sp_list

260    def get_description_textbox(self,
261                                frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
262                                colored: bool = True,
263                                font: pygame.font.Font = Fonts.MINECRAFT,
264                                text_color: color_t = Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR,
265                                line_margin: int = 5,
266                                wmargin: int = 5, hmargin: int = 5
267                                ) -> Textbox:
268        """
269        Creates the textbox for the info frame.
270        If colored == True, self.colored_description will be used as the text for the textbox.
271        Otherwise self.description will be used.
272        wmargin, hmargin specify the margins inside the textbox, between frame and text.
273        """
274
275        return Textbox(frame_dim,
276                        font,
277                        (self._colored_description if colored else self._description),
278                        line_length=self._description_line_length,
279                        paragraph_length=self._description_lines_per_page,
280                        wmargin=wmargin,
281                        hmargin=hmargin,
282                        text_color=text_color,
283                        centered=True,
284                        text_colored=colored
285                        )

287    def get_areas(      self,
288                        frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
289                        height_distributions: list[float],
290                        hmargin: float = 0.2,
291                        vmargin: float = 0.2
292                        ) -> list[pygame.Rect]:
293        """
294        Calculates the different areas for the info page.
295
296        Traditionally this does:
297
298        areas = get_areas()
299
300        areas[0] | The area into which the headline will be rendered.
301        areas[1] | The first divider area (empty).
302        areas[2] | The image area.
303        areas[3] | The second divider area.
304        areas[4] | The textbox area
305        areas[5] | The final divider area
306        """
307
308
309        frame_dim = graphics.apply_margins(frame_dim, hmargin, vmargin)
310        x, y, w, h = frame_dim.x, frame_dim.y, frame_dim.width, frame_dim.height
311        heights = [int(hp *  h) for hp in height_distributions]
312
313        back = []
314        cy = frame_dim.y
315
316        for height in heights:
317
318            back.append(pygame.Rect(x, cy, w, height))
319
320            cy += height
321
322        return back
323
324
325    def get_info_page_parts(    self,
326                                frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
327                                font: pygame.font.Font = Fonts.MINECRAFT,
328                                hmargin: float = 0.1, vmargin: float = 0.1,
329                                chars_per_line: int = 50, lines_per_page: int = 5,
330                                height_distributions: list[float] = [0.1, 0.05, 0.45, 0.1, 0.25, 0.05],#equals: headline area, distance, card image area, distance, textbox area, distance
331                                rendered_image_path: str = None
332
333                                ) -> InfoPagePartContainer:
334
335        """
336        Renders all significant parts for the info page, then returns
337        a InfoPagePartContainer object.
338
339        hmargin and vmargin specify the margins applied to frame_dim before rendering.
340        """
341
342        if not fequal(1.0, sum(height_distributions)):
343            raise RuntimeError("Height Distributions must add up to 1")
344
345        if rendered_image_path is None:
346            rendered_image_path = self.card_image_path
347        #returns a part list, should be used by the render_info_page_parts method
348        x, y, w, h = frame_dim.x, frame_dim.y, frame_dim.width, frame_dim.height
349
350        render_frame = graphics.apply_margins(pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h), hmargin, vmargin)
351
352        headline_area, headline_image_dist_r, image_area,\
353        image_description_dist_r, description_area, description_bottom_dist_r = self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin=hmargin, vmargin=vmargin)
354
355        headline_image_dist, image_description_dist, description_bottom_dist = headline_image_dist_r.h ,image_description_dist_r.h, description_bottom_dist_r.h
356
357        rwidth = render_frame.width
358        rheight = render_frame.height
359
360        headline, headline_pos = None, None
361        image, image_pos = None, None
362        description_textbox = None
363
364        fullcard_surf, fullcard_surf_pos = None, None
365        fullcard, fullcard_pos = None, None
366
367        headline = self.get_name_rendered(headline_area, font=font)
368
369        if rendered_image_path == self.card_image_path:
370            image, image_pos = self.get_card_image_rendered(image_area)
371        elif rendered_image_path == self.standard_image_path:
372            image, image_pos = self.get_standard_image_rendered(image_area)
373
374        full_image, full_image_pos = self.get_card_image_rendered(render_frame)
375
376        true_description_area = graphics.apply_margins(description_area, 0.2, 0.2)
377        line_rect = true_description_area.copy()
378        line_rect.height //= lines_per_page
379
380        description_textbox = self.get_description_textbox(
381                                                            frame_dim=description_area,
382                                                            colored=True,
383                                                            font=font,
384                                                            text_color=Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR
385                                                            )
386
387        description_textbox.show_pagenumber()
388
389        return Renderable_CardInfo.InfoPagePartContainer(
390                                                        frame_dim=frame_dim.copy(),
391                                                        headline=headline,
392                                                        image_surface=image,
393                                                        image_pos=image_pos,
394                                                        textbox=description_textbox,
395                                                        textbox_pos=(line_rect.x, line_rect.y),
396                                                        full_image_surface=full_image,
397                                                        full_image_pos=full_image_pos,
398                                                        areas=self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin, vmargin)
399                                                    )
400
401    def render_info_page_parts( self,
402                                screen: pygame.Surface,
403                                info_page_part_container: InfoPagePartContainer,
404                                page_index: int = -1,
405                                background_color: color_t = Colors.BLACK,
406                                textbox_outline_size: int = None,
407                                textbox_outline_color: int = None,
408                                full_image_shown: bool = False
409                                ) -> None:
410
411        """
412        Given the surface to render onto and the info_page_part_container, this function
413        renders the info page onto screen.
414        page_index specifies the page shown inside the textbox, background_color
415        the background color of the info frame.
416        If full_image_shown == True, the full image will be shown on top of the info page.
417        """
418
419        tbox = info_page_part_container.textbox
420        full_image, full_image_pos = info_page_part_container.full_image_surface, info_page_part_container.full_image_pos
421
422        if page_index != -1:
423            tbox.skip_to_page(page_index)
424
425        if textbox_outline_size is not None:
426            tbox.set_outline_size(textbox_outline_size)
427        if textbox_outline_color is not None:
428            tbox.set_outline_color(textbox_outline_color)
429
430        screen.fill(background_color)
431
432        tbox.render(screen)
433
434        for surf, pos in info_page_part_container.get_blit_surface_position_tuples():
435            screen.blit(surf, pos)
436
437        tbox.render(screen)
438
439        if full_image_shown:
440
441            tsurf = pygame.Surface(screen.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
442            tsurf.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 180))
443
444            tsurf.blit(full_image, (full_image_pos[0], full_image_pos[1]))
445
446            screen.blit(tsurf, (0, 0))

288    def get_areas(      self,
289                        frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
290                        height_distributions: list[float],
291                        hmargin: float = 0.2,
292                        vmargin: float = 0.2
293                        ) -> list[pygame.Rect]:
294        """
295        Calculates the different areas for the info page.
296
297        Traditionally this does:
298
299        areas = get_areas()
300
301        areas[0] | The area into which the headline will be rendered.
302        areas[1] | The first divider area (empty).
303        areas[2] | The image area.
304        areas[3] | The second divider area.
305        areas[4] | The textbox area
306        areas[5] | The final divider area
307        """
308
309
310        frame_dim = graphics.apply_margins(frame_dim, hmargin, vmargin)
311        x, y, w, h = frame_dim.x, frame_dim.y, frame_dim.width, frame_dim.height
312        heights = [int(hp *  h) for hp in height_distributions]
313
314        back = []
315        cy = frame_dim.y
316
317        for height in heights:
318
319            back.append(pygame.Rect(x, cy, w, height))
320
321            cy += height
322
323        return back

326    def get_info_page_parts(    self,
327                                frame_dim: pygame.Rect,
328                                font: pygame.font.Font = Fonts.MINECRAFT,
329                                hmargin: float = 0.1, vmargin: float = 0.1,
330                                chars_per_line: int = 50, lines_per_page: int = 5,
331                                height_distributions: list[float] = [0.1, 0.05, 0.45, 0.1, 0.25, 0.05],#equals: headline area, distance, card image area, distance, textbox area, distance
332                                rendered_image_path: str = None
333
334                                ) -> InfoPagePartContainer:
335
336        """
337        Renders all significant parts for the info page, then returns
338        a InfoPagePartContainer object.
339
340        hmargin and vmargin specify the margins applied to frame_dim before rendering.
341        """
342
343        if not fequal(1.0, sum(height_distributions)):
344            raise RuntimeError("Height Distributions must add up to 1")
345
346        if rendered_image_path is None:
347            rendered_image_path = self.card_image_path
348        #returns a part list, should be used by the render_info_page_parts method
349        x, y, w, h = frame_dim.x, frame_dim.y, frame_dim.width, frame_dim.height
350
351        render_frame = graphics.apply_margins(pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h), hmargin, vmargin)
352
353        headline_area, headline_image_dist_r, image_area,\
354        image_description_dist_r, description_area, description_bottom_dist_r = self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin=hmargin, vmargin=vmargin)
355
356        headline_image_dist, image_description_dist, description_bottom_dist = headline_image_dist_r.h ,image_description_dist_r.h, description_bottom_dist_r.h
357
358        rwidth = render_frame.width
359        rheight = render_frame.height
360
361        headline, headline_pos = None, None
362        image, image_pos = None, None
363        description_textbox = None
364
365        fullcard_surf, fullcard_surf_pos = None, None
366        fullcard, fullcard_pos = None, None
367
368        headline = self.get_name_rendered(headline_area, font=font)
369
370        if rendered_image_path == self.card_image_path:
371            image, image_pos = self.get_card_image_rendered(image_area)
372        elif rendered_image_path == self.standard_image_path:
373            image, image_pos = self.get_standard_image_rendered(image_area)
374
375        full_image, full_image_pos = self.get_card_image_rendered(render_frame)
376
377        true_description_area = graphics.apply_margins(description_area, 0.2, 0.2)
378        line_rect = true_description_area.copy()
379        line_rect.height //= lines_per_page
380
381        description_textbox = self.get_description_textbox(
382                                                            frame_dim=description_area,
383                                                            colored=True,
384                                                            font=font,
385                                                            text_color=Colors.STANDARD_TEXT_COLOR
386                                                            )
387
388        description_textbox.show_pagenumber()
389
390        return Renderable_CardInfo.InfoPagePartContainer(
391                                                        frame_dim=frame_dim.copy(),
392                                                        headline=headline,
393                                                        image_surface=image,
394                                                        image_pos=image_pos,
395                                                        textbox=description_textbox,
396                                                        textbox_pos=(line_rect.x, line_rect.y),
397                                                        full_image_surface=full_image,
398                                                        full_image_pos=full_image_pos,
399                                                        areas=self.get_areas(frame_dim, height_distributions, hmargin, vmargin)
400                                                    )

402    def render_info_page_parts( self,
403                                screen: pygame.Surface,
404                                info_page_part_container: InfoPagePartContainer,
405                                page_index: int = -1,
406                                background_color: color_t = Colors.BLACK,
407                                textbox_outline_size: int = None,
408                                textbox_outline_color: int = None,
409                                full_image_shown: bool = False
410                                ) -> None:
411
412        """
413        Given the surface to render onto and the info_page_part_container, this function
414        renders the info page onto screen.
415        page_index specifies the page shown inside the textbox, background_color
416        the background color of the info frame.
417        If full_image_shown == True, the full image will be shown on top of the info page.
418        """
419
420        tbox = info_page_part_container.textbox
421        full_image, full_image_pos = info_page_part_container.full_image_surface, info_page_part_container.full_image_pos
422
423        if page_index != -1:
424            tbox.skip_to_page(page_index)
425
426        if textbox_outline_size is not None:
427            tbox.set_outline_size(textbox_outline_size)
428        if textbox_outline_color is not None:
429            tbox.set_outline_color(textbox_outline_color)
430
431        screen.fill(background_color)
432
433        tbox.render(screen)
434
435        for surf, pos in info_page_part_container.get_blit_surface_position_tuples():
436            screen.blit(surf, pos)
437
438        tbox.render(screen)
439
440        if full_image_shown:
441
442            tsurf = pygame.Surface(screen.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
443            tsurf.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 180))
444
445            tsurf.blit(full_image, (full_image_pos[0], full_image_pos[1]))
446
447            screen.blit(tsurf, (0, 0))

This class defines how the info text for a card is is rendered. The info text describes the cards functionality.

This class works by first getting the page parts to render with positions as a container class using Renderable_CardInfo.get_info_page_parts, then some time later rendering the page parts to the given screen by passing the container class to Renderable_CardInfo.render_info_page_parts

161        """

413        Given the surface to render onto and the info_page_part_container, this function
414        renders the info page onto screen.
415        page_index specifies the page shown inside the textbox, background_color
416        the background color of the info frame.
417        If full_image_shown == True, the full image will be shown on top of the info page.
418        """
419
420        tbox = info_page_part_container.textbox
421        full_image, full_image_pos = info_page_part_container.full_image_surface, info_page_part_container.full_image_pos
422
423        if page_index != -1:
424            tbox.skip_to_page(page_index)
425
426        if textbox_outline_size is not None:
427            tbox.set_outline_size(textbox_outline_size)
428        if textbox_outline_color is not None:
429            tbox.set_outline_color(textbox_outline_color)
430
431        screen.fill(background_color)
432
433        tbox.render(screen)
434
435        for surf, pos in info_page_part_container.get_blit_surface_position_tuples():
436            screen.blit(surf, pos)
437
438        tbox.render(screen)
439
440        if full_image_shown:
441
442            tsurf = pygame.Surface(screen.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
443            tsurf.fill((*Colors.BLACK, 180))
444
445            tsurf.blit(full_image, (full_image_pos[0], full_image_pos[1]))
446
447            screen.blit(tsurf, (0, 0))
